text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaahhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Uryaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: (I'm done for?! No, wait—)

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I'll hold it back somehow!
Gwaaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Furioso! It's Furioso!
On the stage of Ohi, she has somehow managed
to overpower the JRA contenders!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, whew, whew...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
(I managed to win somehow... Espo-san was scary,
but what was far more terrifying was...)

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Congratulations, Furioso-san!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Falcon-san...
Are you... not out of breath at all?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I'm fine now.
I lost today, but...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I'll do my best next time!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I can keep getting stronger and stronger without limit!
As long as it brings joy to all my fans!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: (This... person is...)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon!
Just as rumored, her future potential is truly fearsome!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Or perhaps, she is a prodigy capable of standing shoulder to shoulder with the Crimson Nova.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: (Standing alongside Crimson Nova-san... No... that's not it.)

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
(She's not an Umamusume you can measure by such standards.
Her running ability is high, but what's even scarier is...)

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone in the audience! Everyone watching at home!
Thanks for all your cheers!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Next time, I'll show you an even more incredible race.
So keep supporting Falco as she aims for Position 0 at center stage next time too—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Cheer for me, okay?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (UOOOOOOH!!)

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
(She has... everything.
Skill, popularity, charisma...)

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: (In terms of raw ability alone, Crimson Nova-san might be superior. But...)

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
(If Falcon-san takes the lead,
she'll take everything with her...
The glory, the spotlight, everything...)

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
A light dazzling enough to overshadow even Funabashi...
This person... She must be the one...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
It's the Central.
The very embodiment of the Central's existence.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I could clearly tell what Furioso was feeling.
The eve of the birth of a dirt superstar...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today was only their first match. But if Furioso
loses to Smart Falcon in their next clash...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The next strongest Umamusume will be Smart Falcon.
The champion will once again rise from the JRA.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Furioso's era will never come.
Which means neither will Funabashi's...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Furioso-san, give it even more next time!
Will you stand on the same stage with me again?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Ugh...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
...Of course.
The real match is next...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Let's settle this with the next one.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Yeah! If we're gonna do it, let's do it where it'll be most exciting.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
At Funabashi, where Furioso-san
has so many fans.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
In Funabashi...? But the only GⅠ held at Funabashi
is the Kashiwa Kinen next May...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
That's how it usually is, but come on!
This year is special.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Alright, time for a quiz for Furioso!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
The GⅠ 'JBC Classic' changes venues every year.
Where do you think it's being held this year?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: The JBC Classic... This year's...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Ah, Funabashi!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ding-dong, correct!♪
Restoration finished in time, so that means
it should be able to be held at Funabashi in November, right?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: The distance is 1800m, but are you alright with that?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Of course. But are you sure you're
okay with that, Falcon-san?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Since Funabashi is my home turf,
I should have the edge in crowd support...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I don't mind at all.
Because...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Umadols are invincible everywhere♪
Both in our running and in our fan count, you know♪

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: What's with you guys glaring at each other? I was planning on entering a different race anyway, so...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Well, have at each other all you want!
Until one of you wins for real!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —And thus, the stage was set for the decisive battle this autumn.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, about our next race...
To be honest...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"...I have nothing but a bad feeling about this.
I can't stop shivering..."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: "If I lose and end up fueling Falcon-san's momentum――"

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Soon, no one...
will ever reach her heights again...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Everyone began looking solely at her,
soaring through the air...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"I have a feeling that's the case. We have to somehow
put a stop to her rapid growth."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She was still just a fledging chick this spring.
But half a year from now, there's no way Smart Falcon will stay as she is.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Soaring into Funabashi in autumn comes a fully matured bird.
A Super Umadol equipped with giant wings.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I want to win.
I must win, no matter what.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: "If we secure a complete victory here, then surely our... Funabashi's era will begin."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: To fulfill my dream, without fail!!
choice_data_list: Yeah! Nothing less than total victory!
Yeah! Victory is our only option!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even after you defeat the reigning champion, the next contender appears.
This is—the sheer depth of the Central field.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before the final showdown at the JBC Classic,
I must acquire the strength to defeat them no matter what.
